content:
Honoured to have received the Excellence in Education Award from the Hon’ble Chief Minister of Haryana, Shri Nayab Singh Saini. 🏆✨

This recognition is a proud milestone in my academic journey and a reminder to keep striving for excellence.

Grateful for the encouragement and support that made this achievement possible. Looking forward to continuing to learn, grow, and achieve more. 📚🌱
comment: Recognition in education is meaningful when it translates into stronger learning ecosystems—mentoring, innovation, and opportunities that help future students achieve beyond individual milestones.
